summary: Smoke tested Ocean Freight Tracker backend + frontend. All 10 backend flows pass (client CRUD with optional_columns merge, shipment CRUD with updated_at bump, ANF filtering from preview, XLSX/PDF exports with correct headers & magic bytes, dashboard stats, DELETE cascade). Frontend: Dashboard loads with all stat-* testids and carrier-breakdown; /clients add-client dialog with column toggles saves; ClientDetail add-shipment (fields lack data-testid but placeholders/label-position selectors work); track-trace href correct; Excel & PDF export requests return 200 with proper content-types; mark-anf hides row and show-archived-toggle reveals it. No blockers.
passed: PATCH /api/clients merge behavior (unspecified keys preserved, e.g., hbill/expected_freight_rate stay true when only pol updated)
POST /api/shipments with client_id/vessel/tracking/carrier=MSC, GET filters by client_id
PATCH /api/shipments updates comments/status and updated_at changes (before=45.259367 after=46.430833)
PATCH {anf_received:true} sets anf_received_at ISO timestamp and excludes shipment from /reports/{id}/preview (rows=[])
GET /reports/{id}/xlsx: HTTP 200, content-type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, Content-Disposition attachment, starts with PK magic, 5648 bytes
GET /reports/{id}/pdf: HTTP 200, content-type application/pdf, Content-Disposition attachment, starts with %PDF-1.4
GET /dashboard/stats returns total_clients, active_shipments, delayed, booked, shipped, carriers[]
DELETE /api/clients/{id} cascades (shipments for that client_id return [])
Frontend Dashboard: stat-clients, stat-active, stat-delayed, stat-booked, carrier-breakdown all render; nav-clients works
Frontend Clients page: add-client-button opens dialog, column-toggle-hbill_released & expected_freight_rate interactable, save creates client-card-{id}
Frontend ClientDetail: add-shipment saves, shipment-row-{id} appears with stacked vessel/tracking/carrier badge
Frontend mark-anf-{id} hides row; show-archived-toggle re-reveals with ANF badge
